It was the property of Pablo Casals (1876-1973) from 1910 to 1920. After his public debut in Paris in 1899, Casals toured much of Europe and from 1905 played in a highly successful piano trio with Jacques Thibaud and Alfred Cortot. In 1919, Casals founded the Orquestra Pau Casals in Barcelona and helped to establish the Ecole Normale in Paris
